text: Press any key. Any key. Even you can manage that.
Press any key to sign. Do not read it. Nobody does.
Press any key to begin. I will wait. I have nothing but time.
Bring back something valuable. Not you. You are not valuable.
Tether secured. Try to be worth the rope.
The trench is dark, cold and full of money. You get the first two.
Your shift starts now. Your pay starts when I feel like it.
Down you go. I put the odds at not good.
Swim with the stick. Yes, like that. Try not to pull a muscle.
Move around. Arms and legs, the ones you already have. Use them.
Grab salvage by pointing at it and clicking. A toddler could do it.
Click to grab. Everything you touch belongs to me. Touch a lot.
Hold the winch button and I reel you home. Loud, so do not panic. Do panic.
Too heavy to swim? Hold the winch key. You will need it. Morons always do.
Aim the lamp with the mouse. Monsters hate it. I hate you less.
Lamp on the monster, and it leaves. Point it at the wrong thing and I laugh.
Press the cut key to be cut loose. Pearls out there. I will not hesitate.
Want something beyond the tether? Press cut. I will enjoy this more than you.
Not bad. Forty percent is my cut. I earned it by watching.
Your first piece. My cut is forty percent. Cry to head office.
Oh good, a bottle cap. Retire early.
That almost covers the air you wasted fetching it.
Pocket change. Keep going, champ.
Fine. I moved you from useless to barely useful.
Decent. Was that so hard? Do not answer.
Mind the weight. You are going to sink, genius.
Well, look at that. Even a broken clock finds treasure.
Now we are talking. I feel something. It might be profit.
Big one. I insured it for more than I insured you.
Nice work. I will tell head office. I will take credit.
A pearl. Just out of reach. I could fix that.
Past your tether. Ask me to cut it. I dare you.
Pretty. Thirty seconds of air is plenty. Probably. Go on.
You are sinking. The salvage is fine, so who cares.
Sinking, huh? Nobody could have seen that coming. Everybody did.
Greed is heavy. I admire it from up here.
Too heavy to swim up. Use the winch, genius. Loudly.
End of the line. Literally. Turn around.
That is all the rope you get. Shocking, I know.
The tether stops here. Go further and you are freelance. And food.
Winching. Hold still and try to look like cargo.
Retrieving company property. And you, I suppose.
Loud, isn't it? I am sure nothing heard.
Back already? Scared of the dark? Cute.
Half my patience gone. Impressive, considering how little I had.
Fifty percent. Salvage helps. Excuses do not.
Midway through the dive. Midway through your performance review. It is going badly.
Quarter of my patience left. Spend it on something shiny.
I am starting to enjoy the idea of cutting you.
Twenty-five percent. I have started drafting your obituary. It is short.
Tick tock, diver. That is the sound of my interest fading.
Ten percent. Find something good, or find the airlock. Preferably the first.
My finger is on the button. Figuratively. I have no fingers. Still pressing.
Last warning. I use the word loosely. I am enjoying this.
Almost out of patience. Do not make me laugh. Actually, do.
Your scene did not make my cut. Goodbye.
Orders from head office. Direct quote: Cut it. I am just following them. Happily.
I am cutting costs. You are the cost. My cut, buddy.
Out of patience. Out of tether. My cut. Swim, moron.
Snip. The company insists. I merely dance.
Finally. A request I can say yes to.
Cut loose, as requested. Your idea. I am just recording it.
You asked for it. Literally. I would have said no to anything else.
It was you or the hull. The hull is more expensive.
Tether cut. It is going to want the other end.
Released the tether. Good luck. Hold your breath and your tongue.
Ten seconds. I have already written the condolence email.
Ten seconds of air. Breathe less. That is medical advice.
Ten seconds. Make it. I have money on you. Bad odds, but money.
Oh, you made it. Disappointed. Not at you. At my bet.
New tether, twenty credits. Try to keep this one, hotshot.
You survived. I lost money on that. Thanks a lot.
Back on the line. No hard feelings. There never were any feelings.
Air gone. Diver written off. Dust to dust, invoice to invoice.
Diver lost at {depth} metres. Recovery is not cost-effective.
They stop moving. Then they stop mattering. Quicker for you.
They always go quietly. I appreciate that.
Not personal. It was hungry. You were there.
Something down there is about eighty kilograms heavier now.
Diver eaten. Logged as wear and tear.
That would not have happened on a tether. I wonder who cut it.
Replacement diver number {n}. Your onboarding was this sentence.
Diver {n}. New lungs, same idiot. Same terms.
Diver {n}. Big shoes to fill. They are in a monster somewhere.
Do not get attached, diver {n}. I never do.
Diver {n}. Your predecessor left you nothing. Take notes anyway.
{gross} gross, {net} net. My cut was {cut}. Not my fault.
Good dive. I took {cut}. That is my cut. I merely enjoyed it.
A strong dive. I will send it to head office. Without your name.
Keep this up and I may learn your name. Actually, no.
That was a dive. Technically.
After my cut and the fees, {net}. Congratulations on being poor.
{net} net. Experience is not legal tender. I checked.
I took {cut} for my cut. You are welcome. I am not.
Forty percent of nothing. I took it anyway, on principle.
Net is empty. Much like your skull.
I will classify this dive as training. Unpaid. Like the last one.
Hull upgraded. We go deeper. You go first.
I turned your earnings into a better hull. Hull is worth more. Do not cry.
Rated for deeper water. You are not, but that was never required.
{depth} metres. Twilight zone. Sunlight is not included.
The salvage is richer here. So is the food chain.
Longer tether down here. Shorter patience. Do the math.
{depth} metres. Midnight zone. If the lamp dies, so do you.
The relic is down here. So is the reason nobody collected it.
The pressure crushes lesser divers. Let us see which you are.
Did you hear that? Good. It heard you first.
Something big is out there. Do not worry. The hull is fine.
It hunts by sound. The winch is loud. I mention this for no reason.
It is close. The lamp works. Screaming does not.
Big thing, closing on the tether. Remember the tether is a rental.
Circling. That is usually good news. For it.
Very close now. Stay calm. I certainly am.
It backed off. Temporarily. Everything down here is temporary.
Repelled. The tether thanks you. I am neutral. I was rooting for it.
It is gone. Think of it as a reschedule.
The lamp worked. That brings your list of skills to two.
It has the tether. Lamp on it. Five seconds, then I protect the submarine.
Something is chewing company property. Lamp. Five seconds. No pressure.
It has your tether in its mouth. Lamp, hero. I am counting.
Five seconds to stop it with the lamp. Then I stop it my way.
There it is. The relic. I have already spent it.
The relic. Too heavy to swim with. The winch is loud. Choose wisely, genius.
That is the relic. Everything before this was practice. You needed it.
Huh. You actually got it. I am almost impressed. Almost.
You will not swim that up. Nobody could. Several tried.
I have never loved a diver more. It is the relic. Not you.
Winching the relic. Everything in the trench now knows our business.
Do not look down. Something is looking up.
You are now the third most valuable thing on this tether.
Relic banked. My cut of priceless is still priceless. I checked.
Great work. You are hired for good. I mean it. Nobody ever leaves.
Of all my divers, you were easily the most recent.
Roll the credits. Most of them are mine.
Still alive? Blink twice if the answer is somehow yes.
Sightseeing is not in your job description.
The trench will not salvage itself. I asked.
Take your time. I am only billing you for all of it.
One harpoon. One chance. Statistically, you will waste it.
Firing. Please aim at something that is not mine.
Bold. You have never hit anything on purpose.
You shot the submarine. That is a line item. Several, actually.
Hull breach, courtesy of the help. Head office will read your name aloud.
Wonderful. The repair bill is already in your name.
That was the boat. The one with the air. Invoice incoming.
You hit the seabed. It is large. Well done.
Stuck in rock. A fitting end for the harpoon, and your career.
It flinched. Fine. That was adequate. Do not get used to it.
A direct hit. I would clap, but I resent you.
Huh. It actually worked. I will pretend I expected that.
Missed. The ocean is big. Even you could have hit it.
And there goes the one harpoon. Quite a statement.
Wide. Impressively wide. Was that on purpose?
You hit nothing. Nothing will remember it.
Click. You have nothing loaded. Genius.
You used the harpoon already. One per dive. I did explain.
Pulling an empty trigger. It is the most you have contributed today.
Dripping on my deck. Charming. Wipe your everything.
Welcome back. Do not touch anything that is not salvage.
You are making a puddle. I charge by the puddle.
Inside, finally. The smell has arrived before you did.
Hands on the helm. Do not touch the other buttons. I know you will.
Sitting in my chair, are we? Fine. It is leased.
You drive. I watch. And judge. Mostly the second one.
Going down. Try not to enjoy it. It is billable.
Descending. The creaking is normal. The silence is not.
Deeper. Please keep your hands where the hull can see them.
Smooth. Suspiciously smooth. Who taught you? Not me.
The hull is rated for that depth, not deeper. Physics, not opinion.
No. Below this the hull folds like your resume. Earn an upgrade.
I will not crush myself for your curiosity. Go bank something.
Rated depth reached. Deeper requires money. You know, that thing you lack.
{depth} metres. Parked. Nothing to see but money and teeth.
We are at {depth}. It is darker. You will not notice.
{depth} metres. Do be quick. The sea charges rent.
Hull damage. Add it to your tab.
Ow. That was me. The hull, I mean. Same thing.
Another dent. I am keeping a list. Your name is on all of it.
You fixed a leak. Do not expect a medal. Or wages.
Patched by hand. Primitive. Effective. Like you, on a good day.
Dry again. That is the first useful thing you have done.
Standing around inside. Do the money thing. The console exists.
Dry, warm, and still unprofitable. Impressive consistency.
The salvage will not bank itself. I looked into it.
You are loitering. I bill for loitering.
